title: Lord, Keep Us Steadfast in Thy Word
author: Martin Luther (1483-1546)
credit: Martin Luther, 1541.  Translated by Catherine Winkworth, 1863.

tunes.name: Erhalt Uns, Herr, bei deinem Wort
tunes.composer: Wittenberg, 1543 from Klug's Geistliche Lieder auffs new gebessert

firstLine: Lord, keep us steadfast in Thy Word;
verses: Lord, keep us steadfast in Thy Word;
Curb those who fain by craft and sword
Would wrest the kingdom from Thy Son
And set at naught all He hath done.
Lord Jesus Christ, Thy pow'r make known,
For Thou art Lord of lords alone;
May evermore sing praise to Thee.
Send peace and unity on earth.
Support us in our final strife
And lead us out of death to life.
